title: SIGFPE crash in Wayland client handling when 'Prefer Wayland' is enabled in editor settings
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot-4.4-*, as well as 4.3-*(when adding the argument --display-driver wayland explicitly)
- Not reproducible in Godot 4.2 and below

I was able to and used most of the beta/RC versions for 4.4 without issue up until the release of 4.4-stable using the wayland compositor. It wasn't until 4.4-stable that I encountered this issue, and it seems like this is caused by enabling the 'prefer wayland' option in any project. Doing so prevents me from launching the Godot binary/opening godot and loading the initial project list . This makes me think this could be an issue with Kwin/KDE Plasma 6.4 which I plan to xref this issue with.

I attempted to downgrade libffi, launch via a nested kwin session(using kwin_wayland), and use different rendering drivers(/usr/bin/godot --display-driver wayland --rendering-driver vulkan/opengl3_es) which resulted in the same error.



### System information

CachyOS 6.13.6-2 - Godot v4.4.stable.official.4c311cbee - Vulkan,GLES3 - NVIDIA GA106 [GeForce RTX 3060 Lite Hash Rate] Driver: 570.124.04 - Intel Core i7-8700K @ 4.70 GHz (12 Threads)

This may have been present in 4.4-beta-* as well, but I don't normally test the wayland compositor by enabling/disabling the option.

I would expect godot to either fallback to x11/xwayland as well as at least make it into the project list window,  however it crashes before launching the project list.

### Steps to reproduce

- Enable the 'prefer wayland' option under 'Editor -> Editor Settings -> Run -> Platforms'
- Save and attempt to reload the project using the wayland compositor
